# Providing Water Services Since 1886

## Our States

Aqua provides water and wastewater services across eight states. Click the state you are interested
in to learn more about how we serve our customers.

### Illinois

Aqua Illinois is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 14
counties across the Prairie State. [ Discover Aqua Illinois
][28]

### Indiana

Aqua Indiana is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 15
counties across the Hoosier State. [ Discover Aqua Indiana
][29]

### Ohio

Aqua Ohio is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 20 counties
across the Buckeye State. [ Discover Aqua Ohio
][30]

### Pennsylvania

Aqua Pennsylvania is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 32
counties across the Keystone State. [ Discover Aqua Pennsylvania
][31]

### New Jersey

Aqua New Jersey is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 11
counties across the Garden State. [ Discover Aqua New Jersey
][32]

### Virginia

Aqua Virginia is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 37
counties across the Old Dominion State. [ Discover Aqua Virginia
][33]

### North Carolina

Aqua North Carolina is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 51
counties across the Tar Heel State. [ Discover Aqua North Carolina
][34]

### Texas

Aqua Texas is committed to providing safe and reliable water and wastewater services to 53 counties
across the Lone Star State. [ Discover Aqua Texas
][35]

### Water Quality

Aqua is committed to providing the highest quality water and wastewater services to our communities.
Learn more about the steps we take to ensure we meet the highest possible standards for our
customers, including our programs for lead and PFAS.

[ Explore Water Quality
][36]

### Wastewater

Aqua is committed to maintaining the technology to treat your community’s wastewater in compliance
with local, regional and national environmental quality standards.

[ Learn More About Wastewater
][37]

### Aqua in Your Community

Aqua provides more than just water and wastewater services. Our employees live in and are a part of
the communities we serve. That’s why we are committed to giving back and helping our communities to
thrive.

[ See How We're Helping
][38]

### Water Tips

Surprised by an unusually high bill? Suspect a leak? Want to ensure that your pipes don't freeze in
the winter? We're here to help.

[ See More Tips
][39]

## Partner with Aqua

Is your municipality looking for assistance managing your water and wastewater services? We can
help. Explore what we can do for you with our expertise and willingness to invest in your community.

[ Partner With Us
][40]

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## Revolutionizing the farmer experience, online and onsite.

FarmerCore introduces more convenience for farmers by bringing the entire business to the farm,
putting them at the forefront of a customer-centric network that provides a seamless experience.

[ FarmerCore ][91]
[Silhouette of farmer in field]

## Today’s challenges are tomorrow’s possibilities.

Our purpose at AGCO is to provide farmer-focused solutions to sustainably feed our world. Our
ambition is to accelerate innovation and efficiency to drive positive outcomes for farmers and the
planet. 

[ Read our 2025 Sustainability Report ][92]

## Around the world, farmers are making a difference.

challenges and triumphs of farmers.

## AGCO. Where extraordinary grows.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do
for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work,
building a better and more sustainable world. Join us! 

[ Careers ][98]
[ [AGCO - Your Agriculture Company - Red and white logo] ][99]
AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

## Trading dan Investasi dengan Super App Investasi #1

Pluang adalah super app trading dan investasi multi aset dalam satu platform. Tersedia di iOS,
Android, dan web trading (desktop), Anda bisa trading saham Indonesia (IDX/IHSG), saham AS & global,
crypto, crypto futures, US stock options, reksa dana, emas & perak dengan grafik real-time
TradingView.

Anda bisa belajar trading, menyelesaikan KYC digital, top up saldo, dan download Pluang di iOS,
Android, maupun web. Coba dulu lewat akun demo, konversi saldo USD untuk beli saham AS, lalu mulai
day trading atau investasi jangka panjang sesuai gaya Anda.

Pluang aman dan tepercaya, berizin OJK & Bappebti. Nikmati fitur pro seperti grafik canggih dan
eksekusi order cepat untuk trading maupun investasi jangka panjang, semua dalam satu aplikasi multi
aset yang lengkap dan andal di Indonesia.

Pocket Option is an online broker specializing in binary options trading. With a user-friendly

A trading platform for binary options, it offers a unique blend of accessibility and efficiency for
traders of varying skill levels. In the world of financial markets, it stands out by delivering a
service tailored to quick decision-making and short-term trading. It allows traders to predict the
price movement of many assets.

This platform is characterized by its user-centric design, aiming to simplify the often complex
landscape of options trading. With its intuitive interface and robust support system, Pocket Option
demystifies the binary options market for newcomers while providing depth and comprehensive tools
that seasoned traders look for. It is an environment where strategy and luck intersect, providing a
stage for traders to potentially capitalize on market trends and asset volatility.

At its core is the idea of making trading accessible to everyone. With features like a low entry
threshold, a free demo account for practice and the ability to earn a payout on successful trades,
it’s no wonder the platform is gaining traction among those interested in the binary options space.
The promise of lies in its commitment to providing a streamlined trading experience without

Who we are and how it all started?

#### Our story

We started trading on financial markets more than 16 years ago. We have been devoted to full time
trading since 2011, gaining lots of experience, which we decided to offer to a wider number of

already passed our courses. After long years of working on the trading markets and in education, we
often met ambitious, disciplined traders, that met all the requirements to become successful
traders, but all of them had one underlying problem, inhibiting them from becoming a full-time

powerful image processing tools that allow users to easily perform photo restoration, background

Stellapolar Global Logistics L.L.C-FZ · Dubai, U.A.E.

# Energy, traded with discipline.

Stellapolar is a Dubai-based oil trading company. We source, move and deliver petroleum products
across international markets — and run the trading, logistics and compliance processes that make
every deal reliable.

[Explore Services][7] [Get in Touch][8]
Who We Are

## An oil trading house built on process

From our base in Dubai, Stellapolar develops and operates international petroleum trading flows. We
focus on categories where quality, compliance and reliable supply decide success — and we build the
processes to deliver all three.

01

### Oil Trade & Distribution

We take petroleum products from vetted supply to buyer — managing sourcing, contracts, documentation
and delivery across borders.

02

### Logistics & Supply

We coordinate storage, transport and marine supply through a trusted partner network, keeping
product moving safely and on schedule.

03

### Process & Compliance

Behind every cargo stands documented, audited handling — from quality inspection to final release.
That is our standard.

What We Do

## Services across the trade cycle

An end-to-end offering built around physical oil trade — from deal origination to delivery,
supported by logistics, structuring and compliance.

01

### Physical Oil Trade

Origination and execution of physical petroleum deals across clean and heavy products, matched to
buyer and supplier requirements.

02

### Storage & Terminal Access

Access to storage and terminal capacity through a network of partners, so cargoes can be held,
blended and released on demand.

03

### Logistics & Bunkering

Coordination of inland and marine movement, supply and bunkering — managing routing, scheduling and
delivery reliability.

04

### Trade Facilitation

Contract structuring, documentation and payment frameworks that keep transactions bankable,
transparent and secure for both sides.

05

### Consulting & Compliance

Market intelligence, due diligence and compliance support so counterparties can move with confidence
and full documentation.

06

### Chartering

Access to vessel tonnage across Aframax, Suezmax and VLCC classes to move volume where and when the
market requires it.

Our Trade

## Products we trade

Stellapolar trades a broad slate of refined and heavy petroleum products. Specifications, volumes
and delivery terms are agreed per contract.

Clean Products

### Refined & light
* Gasoil / Diesel EN590 · 10 ppm
* Gasoline Various grades
* Jet Fuel Jet A-1
* Naphtha Petrochemical feed

Heavy & Crude

### Crude & residual
* Crude Oil Multiple origins
* Fuel Oil HSFO · LSFO
* Bitumen Penetration grades
* Base Oils Group I–III

Trade slate is indicative. Available products, specifications and terms are confirmed on a
per-transaction basis.

Working With Stellapolar

## A partner who runs the process

Whether you supply, buy or invest, you work with a Dubai trading house that manages sourcing,
logistics and compliance end to end.

For Suppliers & Buyers

### Reliable counterparty, documented flow

Trade a broad product slate with a partner who manages contracts, logistics and compliance from
origination to delivery — with transparent, bankable processes at every step.

[Start a Conversation][9]
For Investors & Venture Partners

### Structured, operated energy trade

Stellapolar structures, documents and operates petroleum trading flows — from sourcing frameworks to
market delivery. Talk to us about what we can build together.

[Get in Touch][10]
STELLAPOLAR

Stellapolar Global Logistics L.L.C-FZ — oil trading and energy logistics, based in Dubai, United
Arab Emirates.

Office

  ## Thermax
  
  Thermax, founded in 1966 and headquartered in Pune, India, is a USD ~1 Billion company offering
  sustainable solutions in the energy and environment space and a trusted partner in energy
  transition. With a global presence in over 90 countries, and manufacturing facilities – 12 in
  India and four overseas (Indonesia, Denmark, Poland, and Germany), Thermax provides essential
  solutions to industries for clean air, clean energy, and clean water.

### ജില്ലയെക്കുറിച്ച്

ഇന്ത്യൻ ഉപഭൂഖണ്ഡത്തിനായി കേരളം ഒരു മരതകമണികളാൽ അലങ്കരിച്ച മാലയാണെങ്കിൽ, അതിലെ ഏറ്റവും വിലമതിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന രത്നമാണ്
തിരുവനന്തപുരം . നാഷണൽ ജിയോഗ്രഫിക് ട്രാവലർ അതിനെ “കണ്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്ന്” എന്ന് വിശേഷിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനു ഏറെ മുമ്പേ
തന്നെ, തിരുവനന്തപുരം നിർബന്ധമായും സന്ദർശിക്കേണ്ട ഒരു വിനോദസഞ്ചാര കേന്ദ്രമായിരുന്നു.

തിരുവനന്തപുരം (തിരുവിതാംകൂർ കാലഘട്ടത്തിൽ ഇംഗ്ലീഷുകാർ സൗകര്യാർത്ഥം “ട്രിവാൻഡ്രം” എന്ന് വിളിച്ചിരുന്നത്) കേരളത്തിന്റെ ഏറ്റവും
തെക്കേയറ്റത്തുള്ള ജില്ലയാണ്. തിരുവനന്തപുരം നഗരം ഈ ജില്ലയിലെ ആസ്ഥാനവും കേരള സംസ്ഥാനത്തിന്റെ തലസ്ഥാനവും കൂടിയാണ്.

“തിരു-അനന്ത-പുരം” എന്നത് “വിശുദ്ധനായ അനന്തന്റെ നഗരം” എന്നാണ് അർത്ഥമാക്കുന്നത്. ആയിരം തലകളുള്ള ദിവ്യനാഗമായ അനന്തന്റെ പേരിലാണ് ഈ
നഗരത്തിന് പേര് ലഭിച്ചത്. അനന്തന്റെ ചുരുളുകളിൽ മഹാവിഷ്ണു ശയിക്കുന്ന രൂപമാണ് ഇവിടെ ആരാധിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ദൈവിക പ്രതീകം. ഈ മഹത്തായ
രൂപമാണ്.

### ജില്ലയെക്കുറിച്ച്

ഇന്ത്യൻ ഉപഭൂഖണ്ഡത്തിനായി കേരളം ഒരു മരതകമണികളാൽ അലങ്കരിച്ച മാലയാണെങ്കിൽ, അതിലെ ഏറ്റവും വിലമതിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന രത്നമാണ്
തിരുവനന്തപുരം . നാഷണൽ ജിയോഗ്രഫിക് ട്രാവലർ അതിനെ “കണ്ടിരിക്കേണ്ട സ്ഥലങ്ങളിൽ ഒന്ന്” എന്ന് വിശേഷിപ്പിക്കുന്നതിനു ഏറെ മുമ്പേ
തന്നെ, തിരുവനന്തപുരം നിർബന്ധമായും സന്ദർശിക്കേണ്ട ഒരു വിനോദസഞ്ചാര കേന്ദ്രമായിരുന്നു.

തിരുവനന്തപുരം (തിരുവിതാംകൂർ കാലഘട്ടത്തിൽ ഇംഗ്ലീഷുകാർ സൗകര്യാർത്ഥം “ട്രിവാൻഡ്രം” എന്ന് വിളിച്ചിരുന്നത്) കേരളത്തിന്റെ ഏറ്റവും
തെക്കേയറ്റത്തുള്ള ജില്ലയാണ്. തിരുവനന്തപുരം നഗരം ഈ ജില്ലയിലെ ആസ്ഥാനവും കേരള സംസ്ഥാനത്തിന്റെ തലസ്ഥാനവും കൂടിയാണ്.

“തിരു-അനന്ത-പുരം” എന്നത് “വിശുദ്ധനായ അനന്തന്റെ നഗരം” എന്നാണ് അർത്ഥമാക്കുന്നത്. ആയിരം തലകളുള്ള ദിവ്യനാഗമായ അനന്തന്റെ പേരിലാണ് ഈ
നഗരത്തിന് പേര് ലഭിച്ചത്. അനന്തന്റെ ചുരുളുകളിൽ മഹാവിഷ്ണു ശയിക്കുന്ന രൂപമാണ് ഇവിടെ ആരാധിക്കപ്പെടുന്ന ദൈവിക പ്രതീകം. ഈ മഹത്തായ
രൂപമാണ്.
